en: AI helped us build. We chose what mattered.
zh: AI让想法落地，判断让作品成立。
en_script:
Alright, you have seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I will now explain how we built it, and how we could turn it into a sustainable cultural product.

We used Lovable to share ideas and explore what the game could look like.
Then we used Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

We brought these parts together locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.

But building the game was only part of the work.

We still had to choose which stories belonged together, check their historical order, and make each choice clear to the player.

Look at the game on the right.
Behind this scene, the real question is:
What does the player understand—and what will they remember?

If players remember the stories and understand the choices,
then we are offering more than a game—we are offering a way to explore culture.

But where does Civilization Voyage fit in the market?
Let’s look at two products we chose as competitive benchmarks.
zh_script:
大家已经看到了文明航程玩起来是什么样子。
接下来，我会介绍我们如何制作它，以及如何让它成为一个能够持续发展的文化产品。

我们用Lovable交流想法，探索游戏可能呈现的样子。
然后用Claude做设计、Codex处理API，以及Grok完成前端和3D场景。

我们在本机把这些部分整合起来，测试互动，并更新了桌面应用。

但把游戏做出来，只是其中一部分。

我们还要决定哪些故事应该放在一起，核对历史顺序，并让玩家看懂每一个选择。

请看右边的游戏画面。
在这幅场景背后，真正的问题是：
玩家理解了什么，又会记住什么？

如果玩家能记住故事、理解选择，
那么我们提供的就不仅是一款游戏，也是一种探索文化的方式。

但文明航程在市场中处于什么位置？
接下来看看我们选择的两款对标产品。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 面向观众，承接游戏演示。
rehearsal.en:
Alright, you have seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I will now explain how we built it, and how we could turn it into a sustainable cultural product.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧制作流程，介绍Lovable与三个工具的分工。
rehearsal.en:
We used Lovable to share ideas and explore what the game could look like.
Then we used Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

We brought these parts together locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧内容判断，稍作停顿。
rehearsal.en:
But building the game was only part of the work.

We still had to choose which stories belonged together, check their historical order, and make each choice clear to the player.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧游戏图片；两个问题之间稍停。
rehearsal.en:
Look at the game on the right.
Behind this scene, the real question is:
What does the player understand—and what will they remember?

rehearsal.cue_zh: 看向观众，回应上一段的问题；最后一句切换到第二页竞品比较。
rehearsal.en:
If players remember the stories and understand the choices,
then we are offering more than a game—we are offering a way to explore culture.

But where does Civilization Voyage fit in the market?
Let’s look at two products we chose as competitive benchmarks.

zh: 对标竞品，明确我们的优势
en_script:
Discovery Tour and Minecraft Education each give users a clear reason to choose them.
On the left, Discovery Tour offers detailed historical worlds.
In the middle, Minecraft Education offers flexible tools for classroom learning.
So, what makes our game worth choosing?

Our strength is the connection between the stories and the choices.
Four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes bring Chinese and world histories into one game.
Each route follows a historical sequence. Each chapter gives the player a decision to make.
Sharing supplies with a village costs resources today, but can bring support later.
Players see how their decisions shape the journey.

That is the promise at the bottom of this slide:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
This gives us a clear position to build around: a cultural adventure that people take part in.
Our business model carries that experience into three settings: the home, the classroom, and the museum.
zh_script: Discovery Tour和Minecraft Education各有明确的吸引力。左侧是细致的历史世界，中间是灵活的课堂工具。我们的吸引力是什么？是故事和选择之间的联系。四个时代、八条航线、二十四个场景，把中国与世界历史放进同一款游戏。每条航线遵循历史顺序，每一章都有需要玩家作出的决定。分享补给会消耗眼前资源，却可能换来后续支援。玩家亲眼看到决定如何改变航程。底部这句话概括了我们的承诺：一段航程、连贯选择、持续的后果。这是我们要建立的产品定位：让人参与其中的文化冒险。商业模式则将这种体验带入家庭、课堂和博物馆。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左栏、再指中栏；竞品简短带过。
rehearsal.en:
Discovery Tour and Minecraft Education each give users a clear reason to choose them.
On the left, Discovery Tour offers detailed historical worlds.
In the middle, Minecraft Education offers flexible tools for classroom learning.
So, what makes our game worth choosing?

rehearsal.cue_zh: 转向右侧高亮栏，强调我们自己的优势。
rehearsal.en:
Our strength is the connection between the stories and the choices.
Four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes bring Chinese and world histories into one game.
Each route follows a historical sequence. Each chapter gives the player a decision to make.
Sharing supplies with a village costs resources today, but can bring support later.
Players see how their decisions shape the journey.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指底部总结；最后一句自然切到三种产品。
rehearsal.en:
That is the promise at the bottom of this slide:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
This gives us a clear position to build around: a cultural adventure that people take part in.
Our business model carries that experience into three settings: the home, the classroom, and the museum.

en: One core experience. Three reasons to pay.
zh: 共同的内容基础，三种付费理由。
en_script:
These three pictures show three different reasons to pay.
On the left, the player buys an adventure. Our proposed price is sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
The first purchase depends on whether the game looks worth playing. Future story packs would depend on whether people want to come back.
That makes the quality of the experience our first commercial priority.

In the middle, the educator buys help turning that experience into a lesson.
The industrial story becomes material for a classroom discussion: who benefits from a new machine, and who bears the cost?
Our proposed annual service is twelve thousand yuan per institution, including teaching guides, two training sessions, and agreed limits on support.
The reason to renew would be continued classroom use.

On the right, the museum buys a way for visitors to take part in a local story.
Our proposed project price is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
The education and museum offers are proposals, and all three prices need testing.
The commercial logic is to reuse the research and game systems, while charging for the work each customer needs.
Clear limits protect our time and our margins.
The next chart shows why that matters.
zh_script: 三张图代表三个不同的付费理由。左侧玩家购买冒险，完整游戏拟价68元。首次购买看游戏是否值得玩，后续故事包则取决于玩家愿不愿意回来，所以体验质量是商业上的首要任务。中间教育者购买的是把体验用于课堂的帮助：工业故事可以变成讨论材料，让学生讨论机器进步让谁受益、谁承担成本。拟议机构年费1.2万元，含教学指南、两次培训及约定范围的支持；持续课堂使用是续费的理由。右侧博物馆购买让观众参与本地故事的方式：拟价6万元，限定一个主题、三个场景、两轮审读。教育和文博服务仍是提案，所有价格都需要测试。商业逻辑是复用研究与游戏系统，同时对每类客户需要的具体工作收费。明确交付范围，才能保护时间和利润。下一张图解释原因。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧游戏画面和薄荷绿¥68。
rehearsal.en:
These three pictures show three different reasons to pay.
On the left, the player buys an adventure. Our proposed price is sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
The first purchase depends on whether the game looks worth playing. Future story packs would depend on whether people want to come back.
That makes the quality of the experience our first commercial priority.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指中间教学概念图、¥12,000及其下方交付内容。
rehearsal.en:
In the middle, the educator buys help turning that experience into a lesson.
The industrial story becomes material for a classroom discussion: who benefits from a new machine, and who bears the cost?
Our proposed annual service is twelve thousand yuan per institution, including teaching guides, two training sessions, and agreed limits on support.
The reason to renew would be continued classroom use.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧展陈概念图、¥60,000，再回到三栏整体。
rehearsal.en:
On the right, the museum buys a way for visitors to take part in a local story.
Our proposed project price is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
The education and museum offers are proposals, and all three prices need testing.
The commercial logic is to reuse the research and game systems, while charging for the work each customer needs.
Clear limits protect our time and our margins.
The next chart shows why that matters.

en: Growth must pay for the work behind it
zh: 增长，要能承担持续创作的成本。
en_script:
These are planning assumptions for one year.
Our base case combines two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
Together, they produce three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in revenue—the blue bar on the left.

But revenue does not tell the whole story.
The first orange bar takes away delivery and customer acquisition costs.
The green bar is what remains: one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
We then subtract fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan.
The red bar shows the result: a loss of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.

That loss tells us where the work is.
We need affordable ways to reach players, teaching materials that can be used again, and museum projects that stay within scope.
Selling more custom work can also mean hiring more people and spending more cash.
So we would track what each sale leaves after its costs, not just the size of the sale.
This is why our next step is a staged investment.
zh_script: 这是一年的规划假设。基准情况是两千名付费玩家、十家机构、两个文博项目，合计收入37.6万元，对应左侧蓝柱。但收入并非全貌。第一根橙柱扣除交付和获客成本，绿色剩余贡献为16.08万元，再扣24万元固定投入，最后红柱是7.92万元亏损。这个缺口说明接下来要做什么：以可承担的成本触达玩家，让教学材料能够反复使用，让文博项目保持在约定范围内。卖出更多定制项目也可能意味着招更多人、花更多现金。因此我们要看每笔销售扣除成本后留下多少，不能只看订单金额。这就是我们选择分阶段投入的原因。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 先指顶部客户数量，再指蓝色收入柱；明确这是测算。
rehearsal.en:
These are planning assumptions for one year.
Our base case combines two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
Together, they produce three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in revenue—the blue bar on the left.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 从左向右指橙柱、绿柱、橙柱、红柱。长数字慢读。
rehearsal.en:
But revenue does not tell the whole story.
The first orange bar takes away delivery and customer acquisition costs.
The green bar is what remains: one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
We then subtract fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan.
The red bar shows the result: a loss of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 在红柱处停一秒，抬头讲经营判断。
rehearsal.en:
That loss tells us where the work is.
We need affordable ways to reach players, teaching materials that can be used again, and museum projects that stay within scope.
Selling more custom work can also mean hiring more people and spending more cash.
So we would track what each sale leaves after its costs, not just the size of the sale.
This is why our next step is a staged investment.

zh: 让人愿意再来，让故事能够继续。
en_script:
On the left is our proposed funding plan: three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
The three bars cover fixed work, cash for delivery before customers pay, and a reserve.
We would release one hundred and twenty thousand yuan first.

On the right is the order of work.
First, improve the game until players finish a journey and choose to return.
Next, test paid offers with educators and cultural partners, and measure the time and cost of delivery.
Then, use that evidence to decide whether to release the remaining funds and expand the stories.
Over time, each project should leave us with reusable content, stronger relationships, and a better game.
That is how we would turn this first voyage into a lasting cultural business.
zh_script: 左侧是36万元资金规划，三根条分别用于固定工作、客户付款前的交付周转及风险储备。先释放12万元。右侧是执行顺序：先改善体验，让玩家完成航程并愿意回来；再与教育者和文化伙伴测试付费方案，记录交付时间和成本；随后依据证据决定是否释放剩余资金、拓展故事。长期来看，每个项目都应该留下可复用的内容、更稳固的伙伴关系和更好的游戏。这是从第一段航程发展为持续经营的文化事业的路径。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧36万元与三根资金分配条。
rehearsal.en:
On the left is our proposed funding plan: three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
The three bars cover fixed work, cash for delivery before customers pay, and a reserve.
We would release one hundred and twenty thousand yuan first.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 沿右侧三个阶段向下指；最后看向观众。
rehearsal.en:
On the right is the order of work.
First, improve the game until players finish a journey and choose to return.
Next, test paid offers with educators and cultural partners, and measure the time and cost of delivery.
Then, use that evidence to decide whether to release the remaining funds and expand the stories.
Over time, each project should leave us with reusable content, stronger relationships, and a better game.
That is how we would turn this first voyage into a lasting cultural business.

en_script:
Civilization Voyage begins with Chinese civilization and opens onto the world.
Technology changes what people can do. Our stories explore what they choose to do with that power.
We want people to remember the lives behind the history—and their own choices along the way.
A business that lasts gives us the chance to keep telling those stories.
Thank you.
zh_script: 文明航程从中华文明出发，走向世界。技术改变人们能够做什么，我们的故事则关注人们选择怎样使用这种能力。我们希望玩家记住历史中的人，也记住自己一路作出的选择。能够持续的经营，让我们有机会把这些故事继续讲下去。谢谢。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 停留在神殿与船的全屏画面；放慢语速，最后看向观众。
rehearsal.en:
Civilization Voyage begins with Chinese civilization and opens onto the world.
Technology changes what people can do. Our stories explore what they choose to do with that power.
We want people to remember the lives behind the history—and their own choices along the way.
A business that lasts gives us the chance to keep telling those stories.
Thank you.
